# Snapid

> Snapid is a lightweight JavaScript and TypeScript library for generating short identifiers.

## Documentation

- [Human-friendly documentation](https://dhiraj2105.github.io/snapid/): guides, examples, API, and security notes.
- [Complete LLM-friendly documentation](https://dhiraj2105.github.io/snapid/llms-full.txt): plain-text summary of the API and common use cases.
- [Project README](https://github.com/dhiraj2105/snapid/blob/main/README.md)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/dhiraj2105/snapid)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/snapid)
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/dhiraj2105/snapid/issues)

## Key facts

- Current documented release: 1.0.10
- No runtime dependencies.
- Supports Node.js, browsers with Web Crypto, and Deno.
- Default output is a 10-character Base58 string.
- Options: `size` (integer 1–1024), `time` (boolean), `alphabet` (`base58`, `base62`, `hex`), and `seed` (string).
- Unseeded IDs use cryptographic randomness. If no secure random source exists, generation throws.
- Seeded generation is deterministic and is not suitable for secrets, passwords, or unpredictable tokens.
- `time: true` prepends a fixed-width timestamp segment.

## Quick start

```js
import snapid from "snapid";

const id = snapid();
const sortableId = snapid({ time: true, size: 12 });
const hexId = snapid({ alphabet: "hex", size: 16 });
```

For detailed options and examples, read the documentation page or full text reference above.
